name: BunnyFly: Season of Summer
summary:
On a little mysterious island in the middle of an isolated unknown lake, strange creatures exist. Bunnyflies! Little bunny-like creatures with wings like a butterfly.
They fly and collect pollen to chew and bring back to their different hives as honey or wax, where one queen exists to help them all.

Explore this island as Princess Honeybun, the queen's daughter who's now old enough to make her own hive and start her own colony! Help the residents, collect Royal Jelly, and become the next bunny matriarch!

This game was originally created for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam, and has been expanded to have better visuals, performance, more mechanics, a much larger and complex world, higher variety of flowers, characters, a few mini-biomes, and a lot more lore to try and find.
